value.rationale: A complete natural phase-only Fourier support classification for the first nonplanar affine simplex, in every odd-prime vector space of rank >=3, distinguishes 0, one flat, and two intersecting flat zero strata and gives a sharp spectrum size. This precise invariant is motivated by 2026 rank-two parabolic uncertainty and by known rank-two rectangle and p=3 simplex classifications. The result is a structural all-prime statement rather than a routine arithmetic increment.
